verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot's own marketing directly claims the ability to create a shared source of truth for teams that draws context from your docs and repositories, which matches the story. The evidence is a single feature-page line with no setup documentation or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: how-to documentation on creating and managing the shared workspace, details on supported doc sources and team access controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create a shared workspace from my docs and repos as a common source of truth for the team

citations.quote: Scale knowledge and keep teams consistent by creating a shared source of truth that includes context from your docs and repositories.
